resources.string: Connect your %1$s and save weight to Health Connect for Google Fit or Google Health.
Step briefly on your scale to wake it, then keep your phone nearby. Currently supported: %1$s.
No compatible scales found. Wake the scale and try again.
Confirm this is a %1$s. The model number on the bottom should be %2$s. No system Bluetooth pairing is needed.
Step off, then onto the scale to start a new weigh-in
Weight is stable · check your scale display
Saved locally · check writing status in Records
The reading is no longer fresh
Compare the weight above with your scale display. Only do this when adding or rebinding a scale.

While the app is open, new measurements from the selected scale start automatically. Enable automatic confirmation to save after a 5-second countdown. Changing pages, leaving the app, or locking cancels the pending reading.
Your confirmed weigh-ins will appear here.
Delete local and Health Connect record
Only this app’s record is affected. Data already imported by a Google app may need deleting there too.
For scales with completed setup, steady readings save after a 5-second countdown, which you can cancel. Only use for your own weigh-ins.

ScaleMate scans your chosen scale only while this app is open. Confirmed weights and device names are stored locally. With your permission, weight and measurement time are written to Health Connect. No account, server, location tracking or analytics are used. You can revoke permissions, unbind scales and delete this app’s records. Other health apps control their own imports.
Bluetooth is unavailable or permission was denied. Enable Bluetooth and allow Nearby devices, then retry.
Scale data could not be verified. Please weigh again.
Local save failed. Please retry; no new health write was started.
Scan timed out. Please wake the scale and retry.
No fresh weight data. Please weigh again.
Could not open this screen. Please check your system settings.
YUNMAI Smart Body Fat Scale 3 SE
Weight permission was not granted. You can still save locally.
Waiting for your scale. Step on to start automatically.
Add a scale and complete a trial weigh-in before choosing how to save.
This scale needs setup. Complete a trial weigh-in and verify its reading before choosing how to save.
This scale is ready. New steady measurements will save after a 5-second countdown.
Your scale is added. Check that your phone reads its weight correctly. Step off, let the scale reset to zero, then step on and stand still.
Setup trial only · no weight record will be saved
Waiting for a trial reading. Step off, then onto the scale.

The readings match. How would you like to save future weigh-ins? Automatic saving uses a 5-second countdown once readings are steady; you can cancel during the countdown. This trial is not saved. You can change this option in Settings anytime.
Scale setup complete. Step off, then onto the scale to start your first regular weigh-in.
Follow these steps to show weights saved by ScaleMate in your health app.
Have Google Fit or Google Health installed on your phone. Already installed? Continue to the next step.
Open or get a health app
Tap below and allow weight writing on the system screen. ScaleMate saves health data through Health Connect.
Allow your health app to read weight
Open Google Fit or Google Health. Find Health Connect in its settings, connect it, and allow reading weight.
Complete this step in your health app. ScaleMate cannot check whether that app has reading permission.
New weigh-ins will sync through Health Connect; your health app may take a little time to show them. You can also use local records without connecting yet.
